reviewed_by: Codex automated metadata analysis; no independent human scientific review is claimed
scope: Existing-source preparation admission authorized by the user: full-source audit, conservative instance preparation, native spectral masks and independent prepared-array validation. Browser execution covers one complete training plot.
limitations: No independent human scientific review, annotation-correctness certification, radiometric calibration, spatial association accuracy, article scoring protocol or geographic generalization is claimed. Source licensing restrictions remain applicable.

provenance.finding: Previously catalogued pinned record. Source metadata passed its provider MD5 and saved SHA256; source-scoped sensors and native headers are documented.

rights.finding: Provider-declared CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 and attribution remain explicit. This publishes metadata, evidence and preparation code; users obtain source data from the provider subject to its licensing restrictions.

integrity.finding: Both provider archives matched pinned MD5 and SHA256; all 19 original LAS SHA256 were recomputed. Every prepared block passed the independent reader.

schema.finding: Native point records, source XYZ, class codes, plot-local identities and official partitions are preserved. Derived references retain unknown masks; three native reflectance channels retain explicit missingness masks. Units, calibration and association accuracy remain unresolved.

coverage.finding: All 60793586 points and 1561 plot-local native tree instances across 13 training and 6 test plots were audited. All 254 prepared blocks were independently validated. The browser acceptance covers 1667254 points in 7 blocks and all NPZ hashes match the native run.

duplicates.finding: No deduplication or model-exposure certification. One acquisition area; 19 plots are not 19 independent geographic zones.

instances.rationale: Conservative source-specific preparation is fully validated. Consume instance_valid and preserve native partitions; benchmark scoring, annotation completeness and geographic independence require separate review.

components.rationale: Outside this metadata review; no task-specific preparation is admitted.

species.rationale: Outside this metadata review; no task-specific preparation is admitted.

geometry.rationale: Native decoded XYZ and point order are preserved, independently verified against native records. No CRS is inferred.

spectral.rationale: Three native reflectance channels and validity masks are independently validated; calibration, units and cross-source comparability remain unresolved.
